target-access.title: FreeBSD iflib porting target host
target-access.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o TCPKeepAlive=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=20 -o ServerAliveCountMax=10 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa root@10.102.18.118
target-access.description: Shell on a host running the destination OS. Use it to compile the ported sources against real FreeBSD headers and to run userspace unit tests.
target-access.notes: Build and userspace tests only. Do NOT kldload the driver or attach it to hardware: this host is shared and a failed attach can wedge it with no console recovery.
